Nine hikers died in 1959 after fleeing their own tent into sub-zero cold. #ForgottenAndFound Investigators reopened the case in 2019, and the leading theory they now favor still doesn't explain every piece of physical evidence the original search team found.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

Sources: Smithsonian Magazine; History.com — "The Mysterious Deaths of the Dyatlov Pass Hikers"; Mental Floss; All That's Interesting; HowStuffWorks — "The Dyatlov Pass Incident: Could an Avalanche Have Killed the Hikers?" (reporting the 2019–2021 Russian prosecutorial re-investigation and the independent snow-slab modeling study).

#ForgottenAndFound #DyatlovPass #ColdCase #RussianHistory #UnexplainedDeaths
